transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Well... my family brought me here. They're upset with me. They say I used up our savings on... wood, and lights, and all this display stuff for the yard. I just kept working on it, even after dark. I couldn't stop. I felt like... if I stopped, the whole house, maybe the whole block, would just... lose its chance. So I had to keep going. But they didn't understand.
Have you been sleeping less than usual lately?
I don't really keep track of the clock. I just... rest when I need to, I guess. Haven't really thought about it.
Have you noticed that you need less sleep than usual, or that you feel rested even if you haven't slept much?
I... I don't know. Maybe. I just haven't felt tired. There's too much to do.
Have you been involved in any other activities lately that have been more intense or excessive than usual, like spending a lot of money, working nonstop, or taking on big projects?

Well, I... I suppose I've been making some calls. Just trying to get things organized. Calling some of the neighbors, you know, and... a few people from my old photography classes. And the hardware stores. Just trying to line up some exhibits, get some building ideas together. Trying to get some work crews going. Just... trying to get it all done at once, I guess. I didn't think it was excessive. Just necessary.
Have you been feeling unusually happy, energized, or maybe even irritable lately?

I guess... I feel charged up. Almost joyful most days. Like I'm young again, honestly. But... well, if my wife or those contractors start questioning what I'm doing... I get hot fast. I just... I start yelling. They just don't understand.
Have you been feeling more confident, powerful, or unusually good compared to how you usually feel?

I... I suppose so. I just... I know what I'm capable of now. I honestly believe I can turn that old Schiller Park house into something important. Something people will actually come see. Because... well, nobody understands light and pictures the way I do. I just see it clearer than anyone else.
How long have you been feeling this way — this increased energy, reduced need for sleep, and heightened confidence?
I guess... maybe three months. Give or take. Just... ever since the remodeling started. Everything in the house just got turned upside down, and... well, that's about how long it's been.

Have you had any period in the last few months where your mood was so high, so irritable, or you felt so energetic that it was noticeably different from your usual self, and this lasted for at least a week straight?
I don't know... I mean, I just told you it's been about three months since the remodeling started. It's just... it's been like this since then. I haven't been keeping track of weeks or anything.

Can you think back and tell me if there was a specific time when you felt this way for at least a full week without letting up — like your mood was so high or you were so irritable that it was really different from your normal self?

I suppose so... yes. Most days lately, I just feel... charged up. Almost joyful. Like I'm young again, you know? But... well, if my wife or those contractors question what I'm doing... I get hot fast. I start yelling. It's just... they don't see what I see. So, yes, it's been like that most days.

Can you think back and tell me if there was a specific stretch of at least seven days in a row where you felt this way — either extremely up, high, or irritable — without it letting up, even for a day?

I thought I just answered that. Yes. Every day. It doesn't just stop. 

Like I said... I feel charged up. Joyful, like I'm a young man again. But then my wife or those contractors start questioning me... and I get hot fast. I yell. It's just been like that straight through. Most days.
